autoExtract.description: After each turn, quietly extract durable facts from what you said.
autoExtract.heading: Learn automatically
autoExtract.label: Learn automatically

clearAll.description: This permanently deletes every stored memory. This cannot be undone.
clearAll.title: Clear all memories?

cloudEmbedding.description: Let memory text be embedded by a cloud provider. Off keeps it on-device (keyword-only).
cloudEmbedding.heading: Allow cloud embeddings
cloudEmbedding.label: Allow cloud embeddings

description: What the assistant remembers about you across sessions.

enabled.description: Recall durable facts about you and inject them into future chats.
enabled.heading: Enable long-term memory
enabled.label: Enable long-term memory

hybrid.description: Combine semantic (vector) and keyword search when recalling.
hybrid.heading: Hybrid retrieval
hybrid.label: Hybrid retrieval

useMemory.description: Allow eligible chats to recall saved memories. Each chat can override this.
useMemory.heading: Use memories
useMemory.label: Use memories

learnFromChats.description: Learn durable facts from eligible chats in the background. Each chat can override this independently from recall.
learnFromChats.heading: Learn from chats
learnFromChats.label: Learn from chats

externalContext.description: Do not learn automatically from turns that used web search, MCP, screen context, or connectors. Local code tools stay eligible.
externalContext.heading: Block external-context learning
externalContext.label: Block external-context learning

queryExpansion.description: Widen the keyword leg with synonym expansion when recalling memories.
queryExpansion.heading: Query expansion
queryExpansion.label: Query expansion

scope.description: Where new memories are stored. Narrower scopes override broader memories with the same stable key.
scope.heading: Default scope

temporary.description: Pause memory for now — neither read nor write this session.
temporary.heading: Temporary mode
temporary.label: Temporary mode
